def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])

            if all(g[i+a][j+b]==2 for a in (0,1) for b in (0,1))]
    dirs={'UL':(-1,-1),'UR':(-1,1),'DR':(1,1),'DL':(1,-1)}
    for (bi,bj) in blocks:
        corners={'UL':(bi,bj),'UR':(bi,bj+1),'DR':(bi+1,bj+1),'DL':(bi+1,bj)}
        raycolor={}
        for k,(ci,cj) in corners.items():
            di,dj=dirs[k]; c=None

            di,dj=dirs[k]; x,y=corners[k][0]+di,corners[k][1]+dj
            while 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w:
